solves.reasoning: 원문: encourage the growth / wrong to exclude them / issues overlooked → encourage-exclude-overlooked
원문: rig our political system / mainstream parties / no overall tendency → rig-mainstream-tendency
원문: committed to liberal / anger and discontent / clear incentives → committed-discontent-incentives
③ embrace는 원문 exclude 교체. '배제하기 위해 조작하는 것은 잘못' 논리에 embrace(포용) 모순
② barrier는 원문 vent 교체. 대중 분노의 민주적 '배출구' 맥락에 barrier(장벽) 모순
④ superficial은 원문 underlying 교체. '근원적' 사회 문제 다룬다는 맥락에 superficial(표면적) 모순
proportional representation will ___ the growth of extremist groups → encourage
it would be wrong to ___ our political system to exclude them → rig
creating clear ___ for mainstream parties → incentives
encourage(조장하다)=promote. restrict/tolerate/evaluate 부적절
address(문제를 다루다)=tackle. locate/deliver/mention 부적절
overlooked(간과된)=neglected. examined/resolved/emphasized 반대·무관
exclude(배제)↔embrace(포용). reject/isolate/prohibit는 유사 의미
discontent(불만)↔satisfaction(만족). frustration/resentment/hostility 유사
(A) name and address=주소, (B) address social problems=다루다 → (A)주소-(B)다루다
the body of people who make the laws → legislature(입법부)
주절 뒤 콤마+분사구문, 능동 현재분사 → creating
전치사 in 뒤 동명사 → highlighting
address underlying problems and to ___ → win back votes
extremist groups standing on ___ → hateful or anti-democratic platforms
